description:
Cast Animation Module by paying {1}.
When Animation Module enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Workhorse.
Animation Module triggers. Holding priority, activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Workhorse.
Repeat from step 3.
